Messages.Author: wedge
Messages.Body:
Can Cavalier be used on a rescue (vampire from torpor) ?

Does it matter who pays?

Matt

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:


"6.5.3. Rescue a Vampire from Torpor

The cardless action costs 2 blood, which can be paid by the acting
vampire or the rescued vampire, or the cost may be split between
them."

Cavalier: "Once per turn, when this vampire successfully performs an
action that costs 1 or more blood..."

Cavalier doesn't say "...that this vampire pays."

So, by card text, yes Cavalier can be used, and no it doesn't matter
who pays it.

-John Flournoy
